content: No, that's incorrect. The capital of Australia is Canberra, which is located in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT). Sydney is the largest city in Australia and is located in New South Wales, but it is not the capital. Canberra was purpose-built to serve as the national capital and is home to Parliament House and other important government institutions.
